title: Body of last missing Batangas jeepney passenger recovered

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Search teams on Monday morning recovered the body of the second and last missing passenger of a jeepney that was swept away by strong river currents in Rosario, Batangas, on October 3, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said. “At approximately 8:30 a.m…. search teams located the remains approximately 800 meters downstream from the spillway along the Pinansingin River in Sitio Kilo, Barangay Colongan,” the PCG District Southern Tagalog said in a report. Before resuming the search, team members met with the victim’s family at the Colongan barangay hall to discuss the systematic downstream search strategy. READ: 1 dead, […]...
